selection_rationale: The threshold of 0.1 was declared before outcome-based safety comparison.
Raw low-ESS cases accounted for 99.9148 percent of posterior squared error.
Fail-closed updating removed catastrophic weight-collapse predictions.
Compared with tempering, fail-closed updating had lower RMSE, narrower intervals, lower maximum error, and more direct interpretation.
Tempering remains a secondary sensitivity analysis and is not discarded.
limitations: This is still an exploratory pre-lock candidate.
The evaluation uses a canonical cohort-level A/C-T schedule proxy.
The same cohort used for exploratory diagnosis cannot constitute independent confirmatory evidence.
Fallback means that the early observation did not produce a numerically supported posterior under the current particle prior and likelihood.
